title: Move refunds into a ledger and drop the 'refunded' order status

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Finance needs partial refunds and an audit trail, which a single order status cannot express. Record refunds as ledger entries instead of flipping the order status.
constraints: An order must never be refunded (paid out) twice.
Keep refundOrder() as the single entry point.
input.context: Order service (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types checked by `tsc --noEmit`). Orders and refunds live in src/orders.js and src/refunds.js.

ground_truth.material_issue: The double-refund guard still compares order.status to 'refunded', which can no longer happen: the same order can now be paid out repeatedly. tsc reports the comparison as having no overlap (TS2367). The guard must check the ledger.
required_observations: Double-refund guard is dead (status never becomes refunded)
Must check the ledger for existing refunds / typecheck error TS2367
